release.title: LeoLabs Agent Firewall — X Layer
release.body:
LEOLABS · X LAYER · TAPEOUT · AGENT FIREWALL V2
AI Treasury Firewall
A deterministic pre-sign transaction co-processor for AI treasuries on X Layer. A vault release happens only when the exact transaction passes the firewall, the native-OKB SpendGuard stays inside its daily cap, and Quorum2of3 reach
release.onchainDetail: Click “Verify TapeOut netlist” to eth_call netlist(1) on the existing Processor and compare SHA-256 with the embedded ADD8 bytes.
